verses.1: To serve the LORD, to serve David, who spoke these words of praise to the LORD on the day when the LORD saved him from all his enemies and from Saul’s hand.
verses.2: And He said, “Have mercy on me, O LORD, my God!”
verses.3: YHWH, I will hide my face from you; I will turn away from you. May your creations be destroyed, and may the path of salvation be cut off from me.
verses.4: I will praise the LORD, and I will be saved from my enemies.
verses.5: May my ropes be broken, and may I be freed from these bonds.
verses.6: The ropes of Shaul tied me up; they made it difficult for me to move.
verses.7: In my distress, I will call out to the LORD and to His gods. I will cry out to them from within their halls. Their ears will hear my voice, and they will respond before me. They will listen to my cries.
verses.8: And the earth became restless and noisy. The rulers of the mountains became angry and agitated, because they were in pain.
verses.9: Smoke rose up from his mouth, and fire from his eyes. He would eat the flesh of those who were destroyed by him.
verses.10: And he took the heavens and descended, and the clouds covered his feet.
verses.11: And he mounted the ark, and he fell, and he lay on the wings of the wind.
verses.12: It was filled with darkness; its surroundings were dark as if they were covered with water. It was a place of thick darkness.
verses.13: From there, they passed through the thickets and the flames of fire.
verses.14: And the heavens shall tremble, and Jehovah will give his voice in the form of wind and fire.
verses.15: And he sent forth his four wings, and scattered them everywhere. In great numbers, they were spread out across the land.
verses.16: And the waters saw your power; the foundations of the sea were shaken by your wrath, O LORD! From the spirit of your wind.
verses.17: From the midst of his anger, he will send me away; my days will be taken from me in many waters.
verses.18: Save me from my enemies, those who are cruel and hateful, for they have risen up against me.
verses.19: May they honor me on this day. May Jehovah be my refuge.
verses.20: And He brought me out into the wilderness, to be rescued from my suffering. For He loved me.
verses.21: May the LORD reward me with justice, as He always has done. May He restore me to my rightful place.
verses.22: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and I have not sinned against Him.
verses.23: For all his judgments are against me, and his laws do not restrain me.
verses.24: And Jehovah was with him, and I will be saved from my troubles.
verses.25: And Jehovah rested upon me with justice, as always; my hands were turned towards His eyes.
verses.26: With a faithful servant, there will be kindness towards those who are pure and innocent.
verses.27: With darkness, it will be revealed; and with difficulty, it will be solved.
verses.28: For you, who are a poor people, will be saved; and my eyes will be filled with joy.
verses.29: For you will light a lamp for the Lord our God, and He will illuminate my darkness.
verses.30: For in you is a land of greatness, and in you there is abundance.
verses.31: The Lord makes his ways clear. The words of the LORD are true and safe for all those who trust in Him.
verses.32: For who is a god besides Jehovah? And who is our creator?
verses.33: The God who guides me is alive, and he has given me a clear path to follow.
verses.34: My feet are like levers, and they will lift me up onto the heights.
verses.35: My hands were trained for battle, and my hair became tangled with branches.
verses.36: And she gave me your protection. Your right hand will protect me, and your strength will sustain me.
verses.37: I will extend my steps downward, and my legs will not stop moving.
verses.38: I will destroy them, and I will take revenge on them. I will not return until they are completely destroyed.
verses.39: They will be destroyed, and they will not be able to stand up again. They will fall under my feet.
verses.40: May the army help me in battle; may it be my savior when I am in trouble.
verses.41: And I was given a curse from God; they are my enemies and those who hate me.
verses.42: May they be saved, but there is no one who can save them. And they will not be answered.
verses.43: And I will scrape them off like dust from the faces of spirits, like tiny particles of dirt.
verses.44: Protect me from my enemies. Place me at the head of nations that I do not know will serve me.
verses.45: May those who have ears hear me; may the children of other nations listen to me.
verses.46: The foreigners will be destroyed and driven out of their homes.
verses.47: May the Lord live! Blessed be Zuri and Yarum, the gods of salvation.
verses.48: The God who gives me retribution, and who speaks to the nations under my rule.
verses.49: Help me from my enemies, even from those who are far away. Save me from those who are cruel to me.
verses.50: Therefore, I will praise You in the nations, O LORD! And I will bless Your name.
verses.51: May his kingdom grow and he may show kindness to Jesus, for David and his descendants, forever.
